# Basic YAML structural check - count colons and indentation
lines = open('/app/workspace/docker-compose.yml').read().split('\n')
for i, line in enumerate(lines, 1):
    if line.strip().startswith('#') or not line.strip():
        continue
    # Check for unclosed quotes on complex lines
    if line.count('\"') % 2 != 0:
        print(f'Line {i}: odd number of double quotes: {line}')
        sys.exit(1)
    if line.count(\"'\") % 2 != 0:
        print(f'Line {i}: odd number of single quotes: {line}')
        sys.exit(1)
print('YAML structural check PASSED - no quote issues')

svcs = [l for l in lines if re.match(r'^  [a-z]', l) and l.rstrip().endswith(':') and '  ' not in l[2:]]
print(f'Services defined: {svcs}')
"
